claims.location: source name, comment[label], factor value[disease], characteristics[disease] (rows 1-600)
claims.value: pool 1 RRMS=TMT126 (rows 1-100); pool 2 RRMS=TMT128 (101-200); pool 3 RRMS=TMT130 (201-300); pool 4 OND=TMT127 (301-400); pool 5 OND=TMT129 (401-500); pool 6 OND=TMT131 (501-600)
claims.evidence: Paper Table 1, row 'TMT label global proteome analysis': Pool 1..6 = 126, 128, 130, 127, 129, 131; row 'Diagnosis': Pools 1-3 RRMS, Pools 4-6 OND. The separate 'deglycoproteome analysis' label row belongs to PXD004540 and was not used.
Methods 'CSF collection and patient information': 21 RRMS patients diagnosed by revised McDonald criteria; PRIDE keyword 'Multiple sclerosis'

Methods: '21 controls with other neurological diseases (OND) ... evaluated by a neurologist to have no risk of developing MS'. Specific diagnoses are in Table S1, which was not accessible; the generic MONDO parent is used rather than 'normal'.
PRIDE organism Homo sapiens, organism part Cerebrospinal fluid; Methods: CSF collected by diagnostic lumbar puncture at Haukeland University Hospital

claims.location: characteristics[pooled sample], characteristics[individual], characteristics[biological replicate] (all rows)
claims.value: pooled; pooled; 1,2,3 within each diagnosis group
claims.evidence: Methods 'Preparation of pooled samples': 42 CSF samples randomly divided into three RRMS pools and three OND pools, seven individuals each, 200 ug protein per donor. Biological replicate = pool index within its group (RRMS pools 1-3 -> 1-3; OND pools 4-6 -> 1-3).
Table 1: each pool is 1 male / 6 female with mean age 34.1-38.3 y; no single per-sample value exists. 'pooled' (spec-permitted) is rejected by the installed validator for these two columns.
Methods: 'None of the RRMS patients received medication prior to the LP.' Nothing is stated for OND controls.
Methods 'Global proteome analysis': 500 ug of each pool immunodepleted on MARS Hu-14 (Agilent)
Cell-free CSF proteome of pooled donors; no per-sample ancestry reported

claims.location: comment[proteomics data acquisition method], comment[dissociation method], comment[collision energy], comment[ms2 mass analyzer], comment[ms1 scan range] (all rows)
claims.evidence: Methods 'Liquid chromatography mass spectrometry analysis': data-dependent acquisition, top 12, HCD at normalized collision energy 32%, MS2 at R=60,000 (Orbitrap), MS1 scan range 375-1500 m/z
Methods 'Sample fractionation': mixed-mode chromatography on a Sielc Promix MP column, Agilent 1260 LC; no more specific PRIDE child of PRIDE:0000550 for mixed-mode

Inferred: 'Chemical, reagents and solutions' lists IAA and DTT as purchased reagents; digestion 'as described in ref 25' (protocol not re-read); Carbamidomethyl C fixed in the deposited search is consistent with IAA alkylation

limitations: Supplementary Tables S1-S3 (per-donor patient data, fractionation gradient, LC methods per fraction) are on the ACS site (HTTP 403) and were not read.
OND control diagnoses are per-individual in Table S1; the pools are annotated with the generic MONDO 'nervous system disorder'.
Age and sex are pool-level summaries (1M/6F per pool; means 34.1-38.3 y); written as 'not available' / 'not applicable' because the validator rejects 'pooled' for these columns.

Fraction identifiers are taken from the number embedded in each file name; the reruns/'newgrad'/'normgrad_2ul' suffixes are treated as the single deposited acquisition of that fraction (no duplicate fraction numbers exist).
DTT/IAA are inferred from the reagent list, not from an explicit step description.
Per-fraction LC gradients differ (Table S3, not read); no per-row LC method column was added.
